scope: Three archived full-city public roots, fresh model/inference caches per method; common4world tapes, same causal nominal tail, same512 physical transition budget. No actual-day policy run.
timing_scope: Fresh totals include public-context conditioning, router/bank setup and all planning/bounds. Input load, training fit, graph construction are shared and separately reported. CPU cost is not charged to the passenger event clock.

physical_first_action_diagnostic.scope: After-query physical first-action diagnostic only; actual endpoints were not used by either planner.
